title: Commuting base-change square for the Picard cup transpose
statement: Let f:X→S, j:W→S and h:T→W be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], and E a finite locally free O_X-module [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Assume the canonical adjunction units at O_W for X_W→W and at O_T for X_T→T are invertible [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Assume P(f,E,j) [def-sc-picard-direct-image-rank-condition]. Set N_W=p_W*q_W^*E and D_W=p_W*q_W^*(dual E), and define N_T,D_T similarly, using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. For the explicit cup transposes φ_W,φ_T [def-sc-picard-cup-product-map] there exist isomorphisms a:h^*D_W≅D_T and b:h^*(dual N_W)≅dual N_T such that h^*φ_W followed by b equals a followed by φ_T. This is a commuting square of morphisms; it asserts no invertibility criterion for any counit.

source.place: penultimate paragraph, compatibility with arbitrary base change; final paragraph, degree-zero cup product and its evaluation formula

proof.text: Apply picardDirectImageBaseChangeMap_isIso to the primal and dual base-change IsIso hypotheses supplied by the final conjunct of the rank condition. These are the actual non-iterated maps constructed from the direct square.
The first conjunct makes the primal direct image N finite locally free. Apply picardTensorDualComparison_isIso h N to the specified transpose of pulled evaluation.

Apply picardCupPairing_baseChange to the cup pairings. The proved generic theorem picardBaseChangeSquare_of_pairings constructs a from the dual direct-image map and b from the canonical dual comparison followed by inverse dual of the primal map. Its uncurrying and cancellation argument gives the required square.

proof_origin.place: Final two paragraphs; explicit comparison maps, pairing compatibility, and categorical transposition.

theorem picardCupProduct_baseChange_square
    {X S W T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (j : W ⟶ S) (h : T ⟶ W)
    (hO : IsIso ((Classical.choose
      (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f j))).unit.app
        (SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hOT : IsIso ((Classical.choose
      (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f (h ≫ j)))).unit.app
        (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hR : PicardDirectImageRankCondition f E j) :
    ∃ (a : (Modules.tensorPullback h).obj
        ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f j)).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f j)).obj (Modules.dual E))) ≅
        (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f (h ≫ j))).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ j))).obj (Modules.dual E)))
      (b : (Modules.tensorPullback h).obj
        (Modules.dual ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f j)).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f j)).obj E))) ≅
        Modules.dual ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f (h ≫ j))).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ j))).obj E))),
      (Modules.tensorPullback h).map (picardCupProductMap f E j hO) ≫ b.hom =
        a.hom ≫ picardCupProductMap f E (h ≫ j) hOT
